hero.title: About Green Hill Facilities
hero.description: 9+ years of protecting people, property and reputation across Delhi NCR.

story.description: Green Hill Facilities was founded in 2017 on a simple idea: security in Delhi NCR was being sold as uniforms and headcount, not accountability. We built an in-house, salaried workforce instead — backed by structured operations, independent audits and full statutory compliance. What began as a single site has grown into a team of 500+ trained personnel across 10+ client groups, without ever compromising on that original discipline.
